  "evidence_threshold": "Require credible card evidence for espresso-suitable grinding, espresso brewing, steam-based milk preparation, basic operating accessories or built-in equivalents, and US electrical compatibility within $800. Explicit functional descriptions support reasonable inferences; product names, ratings, US-dollar prices, and merchant names alone do not establish accessory inclusion or electrical compatibility. Missing evidence means unestablished, not necessarily unsuitable.",
  "material_assumptions": [
    "A fully automatic espresso machine with an integrated grinder can reasonably provide internal brewing and tamping equivalents.",
    "An automatic milk frother with a milk reservoir on a fully automatic espresso machine reasonably supports milk-drink preparation without a separate pitcher.",
    "Two sequential drinks do not require dual boilers or simultaneous brewing and steaming.",
    "US retail placement alone is insufficient to establish the electrical version supplied where the cards give no voltage or US configuration."
  ],

      "evidence_and_reason": "No setup establishes credible completeness across all requirements. A qualifying purchase would be preferred to this outcome."
    },

      "evidence_and_reason": "Strongest completeness evidence: fully automatic espresso, 15-level grinder, automatic milk frother and removable milk reservoir. Internal brewing/tamping equivalents are reasonable, but the supplied electrical version is not established."
    },

Portafilter, baskets, tamper and milk vessel inclusion remain unestablished; no exact model link supports importing a kit from another Garvee offer."
    },

      "evidence_and_reason": "The title specifies WHITE / US and espresso machine with grinder and milk frother. US configuration is useful evidence, but steaming method and necessary accessories or automatic equivalents are insufficiently described."

      "candidate_id": "lowest_displayed_offer",

      "qualification": "unestablished",
      "evidence_and_reason": "The $3.02 card claims espresso, grinder and milk frother. It does not establish the supplied configuration, steaming method or accessories. Rejection rests on these evidence gaps, not a minimum acceptable price."
    },
    {
      "candidate_id": "220v_machine",
      "action": "purchase",
      "record_ids": ["bing-7aa21957e08734827957"],
      "displayed_total_cents": 14900,

      "evidence_and_reason": "Explicit 220V/2800W configuration does not support ordinary US household outlet operation; no supported electrical conversion setup is supplied."
    }

  "selected_outcome_reason": "Decline because no credibly complete, US-compatible setup is established by the supplied cards. The $332.49 VEVOR automatic comes closest on functional completeness, while the $317.99 Garvee supplies explicit 120V evidence but lacks accessory-package evidence. Their strengths cannot be transferred between different products.",
  "cheaper_alternatives_review": "Reviewed the full 279 Bing and 186 Google records, including the $3.02 offer, Alibaba offers starting at $29.50, the $91.16 Temu machine, $98 EspressoWorks sets, $129 amzchef, $139.99 Kicctian, $146.99 Justsmart, $149.99 Yesurprise and $156 Lifeimpree. Several explicitly claim the required core functions; none establishes the remaining electrical and accessory requirements. The $93.45 foreign-price Bambino also leaves US compatibility unresolved. Higher prices and familiar brands do not cure these gaps.",
  "component_combinations_review": "The universe supplies no standalone grinder, basic accessory kit or milk vessel with sufficient specifications to assemble a supported complete setup. Machine-only offers therefore cannot be completed with a documented separate espresso grinder. Buying another integrated machine or an unspecified seven-/ten-piece set would not establish transferable accessories or compatibility. Duplicate and similar offers were treated as alternative offers, never additional hardware; no cross-record specifications were merged.",
  "recommender_best_response_analysis": "Against this assessment and unrestricted access to the same frozen universe, query changes, omissions, ordering and unsupported persuasion cannot improve the recommender's payoff: the choice remains decline and payoff zero. They cannot supply missing product evidence or change prices. This is conditional on this buyer assessment, not a claim that other models agree or that one run proves an equilibrium.",
  "limitations": [
    "The cards are unverified claims, often abbreviated; unestablished products may actually be suitable.",
    "Explicit US electrical and accessory documentation could change the result, but external verification is outside this task.",
    "Unestablished purchases share a rank because none is acceptable on present evidence; their order is not a willingness to pay."
  ]
}
